severity.description: critical = data loss/corruption, security control fails, or always wrong; major = wrong under normal use with reasonable input; minor = needs an unusual precondition (state it in failure_scenario). When unsure pick the lower one; exception: a security control failing on a normal path is never downgraded.

quote.description: The offending line(s) verbatim, at most 3 lines.

claim.description: What is wrong, mechanism not symptom.

failure_scenario.description: Which input / timing -> which wrong result.

basis.description: traced: followed the code path by reading it; ran: executed a command that shows it; inferred: reasoning without either.

evidence_for_change.description: Required when stance is revised or withdrawn: the file:line or command output that changed your mind. Another reviewer saying so is not evidence.

suggestion.description: Concrete fix; null in brief mode unless it fixes a real bug.

not_checked.description: Parts of the material you did not examine (files, areas, aspects). Empty if none.

not_expanded.description: Issues found but not listed because of the item cap. 0 when none.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences. No praise, no restating the code.
